items.title: 14.10 Hawa ki aaloodgi se jure mumkina sehat ke khatre (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.10, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Air pollution insanon ki sehat ke liye bare khatre rakhti hai. Sehat par asraat acute (fauri, thori der ke) ya chronic (purane, lambe arse ke) ho sakte hain, aur yeh pollutants ki qism aur concentration, exposure ki muddat aur har shakhs ki apni kamzori par munhasir hote hain. Bare khatre 14.10.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si chaar cheezein tay karti hain ke gandi hawa kisi shakhs ko kitna nuqsan degi?
blocks.explanation: Pollutant ki qism, us ki concentration, shakhs kitni der us ke saamne raha (exposure ki muddat), aur us shakhs ki apni kamzori (jaise bachche, buzurg, dil ya phephron ke mareez).

items: Sehat ka khatra pollutant ki qism, concentration, exposure ki muddat aur shakhs ki kamzori par munhasir; asraat acute ya chronic.
